bodies.interpretation: A known support was a soft objective and was not met; actual normalized loading is not the cause. Stronger flat-foot landing would need extra root/leg adjustment and event-appropriate timing. This is a necessary reach bound, not a solved temporally consistent motion. Root/pose prediction and level-foot assumptions cannot be uniquely separated using monocular data.

existingBasisAffineFeasibilityRelaxation.method: One Chebyshev linear program per body/side, existing13-coefficient basis, all existing known supports. Affine height=current v4 contact height + B*ankleY coefficient delta; coefficients unbounded, reach/floor/smoothness relaxed. No coefficients exported, no clips generated.
existingBasisAffineFeasibilityRelaxation.limits: This is a certificate only for the frozen linearized height model. Changing IK/foot rotations changes shoe skin nonlinearly; not a proof that every exact global solver is infeasible. A right-side lower bound above10mm in this relaxed model means merely raising the old soft weight is not a sufficient demonstrated solution.

nextRepresentationAdmission: All existing clearly observed support intervals, both protected flight intervals and unknown boundaries enter one consistent feasibility problem. Do not optimize only148 or add unsupported roll labels.
Known support geometry is a hard stated authoring condition with a declared contact patch, distinct from detection certainty. Unknown regions receive nonpenetration/reach only, not invented contact.
RootXZ, whole turn, target bone lengths and true flight timing remain constraints; check source-clock preservation.
Contact event boundaries carry unknown velocities unless evidence fixes them; do not use uniform-coefficient soft penalties to silently sacrifice contact.

Accept only if all support residuals, flight clearances, angular continuity, toe/heel geometry and actual runtime-interpolated shoe skin jointly meet gates. Infeasible means report conflicting constraints, not scan weights or relabel source.
